routing_warnings.description: The request for someone with administrator rights to manage advertising concerns ongoing campaign management rather than restoration of the existing profile's advertising access.
The client authorizes setting up another account, which belongs to the alternate-account Requirement rather than the existing-account restoration Requirement.
The clause stating that the freelancer will manage the campaigns without involving the cousin also concerns ongoing Facebook advertising campaign management.
The requested preparation and cousin-account prerequisites concern provisioning alternate account access rather than operating advertising campaigns.
The question about the cousin attending concerns initial alternate-account access setup rather than ongoing campaign management.
